credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Q1 FY27 management PAT claim of ₹4,123 crore matches quarterly consolidated PAT growth to ₹5,480 crore (up 22.5%).
Full-year PAT dropped to ₹19,288 crore in Mar 2026 from ₹22,126 crore in Mar 2025 despite ₹69,781 crore revenue.
Reported revenue growth accelerated from 5.3% in Dec 2025 to 15.4% in Sep 2026 (₹19,856 crore).

bull: PAT growth accelerated to 26.3% YoY in Sep 2026, reaching ₹5,645 crore.
Operating cash flow reached ₹41,727 crore in Mar 2026 with OCF/PAT ratio of 2.16.
Revenue growth accelerated to 15.4% YoY in Sep 2026 at ₹19,856 crore.
bear: Annual PAT fell from ₹22,126 crore in Mar 2025 to ₹19,288 crore in Mar 2026.
Profit lags sales over 3 years with 8.9% PAT growth vs 18.3% revenue growth.
Borrowings expanded to ₹123,120 crore in Sep 2026, raising D/E ratio to 0.63.
watch: Deposit growth, LCR trends, and NIM trajectory.
Borrowing growth after reaching ₹123,120 crore in Sep 2026.
